lines.en: Heavy footsteps thud on the ground

lines.zh: 断腿拖在地上，声音很响。
lines.en: My broken leg drags loudly on the ground.
Rotting fingers claw at the dirt

lines.zh: 我一跑起来，砖缝都在抖。
lines.en: When I break into a run, the brick seams shake.

lines.zh: 断腿甩着，我照样比你快。
lines.en: My broken leg swings and I am still faster.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的手指轻敲地面
lines.en: Knocks on the ground with rotting fingers

lines.zh: 低头寻找可食用的腐肉
lines.en: Bends down to search for edible flesh
Knocks the ground with a broken leg

lines.zh: 我用断指翻找瓦砾下的腐肉。
lines.en: I rake the rubble for carrion with broken fingers.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的眼睛盯着玩家
lines.en: Stares at the player with rotting eyes

lines.zh: 我的膝盖反着弯，挪得不快。
lines.en: My knees bend backward; I don't move fast.
Leg broken askew, I growl low at you.
Attempts to trip the player with a broken leg

lines.zh: 伸出腐烂的手指指向玩家
lines.en: Stretches rotting fingers toward the player
Hit by a projectile, it hurts!
Take a bite, you'll love it!
You must have flesh on you!
Don't go, this is the best food!

lines.zh: 看着我，你就快变成我了！
lines.en: Look at me, you're almost one of us!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，尝尝我的咬吧！
lines.en: You can't escape, taste my bite!

lines.zh: 你撞上我，反被我的胳膊扫中。
lines.en: You bump me and catch my swinging arm instead.
Watch out, my leg will break!
You can't knock me down, I'm alive!
I only go for the hard stuff, you don't cut it!
You dare touch me? I'll kick you one!

lines.zh: 我不会倒下，你打不倒我！
lines.en: I won't fall, you can't knock me down!

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，一起生存！
lines.en: Find my kind, we'll survive together!

lines.zh: 找到你的伴侣，繁殖后代！

lines.en: Follow me, find a new home!

lines.zh: 寻找我的爱人，一起永生！
我和她在废墟里并排走。
lines.en: She and I walk side by side through the ruins.

lines.zh: 我的断腿挡不住我护着你。
lines.en: My broken leg will not stop me shielding you.

lines.zh: 一起面对未来，我的爱人！
lines.en: Face the future together, my love!
Bite of flesh, cannot be healed!
Hunger burns, feasting like a ghost!

lines.zh: 猎物逃无可逃，死路一条！
你跑不过我，这一点要先说清。
lines.en: You cannot outrun me; let us be clear.
I do not walk; I charge.
At the alley's end I have waited long.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块玻璃，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the glass you broke underfoot.
I run the ruins without watching the ground.
Feast on prey, flesh as food!

lines.zh: 你离墙三米，我半秒就到。
lines.en: Three meters to the wall; I need half a second.

lines.zh: 咬伤止不住血，你知道吧。
lines.en: A bite will not stop bleeding; you know that.
Knees bent — I'm about to charge.
Broken leg or not, I still chase you.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，就是路标。
我把你逼到没有转角的地方。
lines.en: I drive you where no corner is left.

lines.zh: 你还在算距离，我已经在跑。
lines.en: You are still measuring; I am already running.

lines.zh: 挥舞腐烂的手臂，试图抓住你.
lines.en: Swings rotting arms, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 痛苦地嘶吼，试图咬住你的腿.
lines.en: Screeches in pain, trying to bite your leg.
Shows sharp teeth, opens mouth to bite you.
Screams as it charges at you.
Slaps at you with its rotting arms.

lines.zh: 痛苦地尖叫，咬住你的脚.
lines.en: Screams in pain, bites your foot.
Squeaks, trying to tear at you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，用力咬你的手臂.
lines.en: Hisses, clamping down on your arm.

lines.zh: 我从拐角冲出来，撞你胸口。
lines.en: I burst from the corner into your chest.

lines.zh: 一口咬在你的肩上，撕开。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder and tear.
My broken leg hooks yours; I pounce.

lines.zh: 我撞翻垃圾桶，碎片飞向你。
lines.en: I knock over a bin; debris flies at you.
The ground is hard when I bring you down.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过你的护颈。
lines.en: My nails scrape your neck guard.
Spawns in the shadows of a cemetery.

lines.zh: 在古老的森林中突然出现.
lines.en: Spawns suddenly in an ancient forest.

lines.zh: 在无人问津的墓碑旁出现.
街角忽然有东西站了起来。
lines.en: Something at the corner suddenly stands.

lines.zh: 一声嘶叫，从废墟里窜出。
lines.en: A shriek, and I bolt from the ruins.

lines.zh: 我没在走，我在等你转身。
lines.en: I am not walking; I wait for you to turn.

lines.zh: 尸变的第一刻，腿就有了力。
lines.en: At the first moment of turning, my legs found power.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，腐肉就卷起来了。
lines.en: One lick of flame and the rotten flesh curls.
Hit by a projectile, it hurts!

lines.zh: 虚空扯住我，连尸身也散了。
lines.en: The void pulls me apart, corpse and all.
